name: Tansyl 5
description: Tansyl 5, also known simply as Tansyl, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Frigosian species. Due to its atmosphere being different from that of Takodana, the Frigosians Thromba and Laparo wore breathing apparatuses around where a humanoid nose would be during their time on Takodana.
lead_paragraphs: Tansyl 5, also known simply as Tansyl, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Frigosian species. Due to its atmosphere being different from that of Takodana, the Frigosians Thromba and Laparo wore breathing apparatuses around where a humanoid nose would be during their time on Takodana.
